name: Texas Live Wire
old_description: Texas Live Wire was founded on a commitment to excellence, safety, and customer trust. Our team of licensed electricians brings over two decades of experience to every job, ensuring that your home’s electrical systems are handled with the highest level of care and professionalism. We’re dedicated to delivering reliable, code-compliant, and efficient solutions for all your residential electrical needs.
about:
Texas Live Wire is based in San Angelo, Texas. The company was founded on a commitment to excellence, safety, and customer trust, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been made public.

The firm provides electrical system design, panel upgrades (100 to 200 amps), electrical maintenance coverage, power distribution, manufacturing machine relocation, motor control center maintenance, large switch gear installation, and preventative maintenance programs such as conductor insulation testing, transformer testing, underground cable testing, and infrared thermographic inspections. It also handles full office renovations, commercial and warehouse lighting, and retail space electrical work. The company does not disclose its facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

Texas Live Wire serves residential homeowners as well as commercial, industrial, and retail clients. Its industrial work includes manufacturing machine relocation and motor control center maintenance, while commercial projects encompass warehouse lighting and retail space electrical installations.

The company says it was founded on a commitment to excellence, safety, and customer trust, emphasizing that its licensed electricians bring over two decades of experience to every job.
